scope: Desktop AiTunnel requests only; backend and other providers retain their existing policies.
implementation: Desktop DI enables at most three total AiTunnel attempts, with 250 ms and 500 ms coroutine delays.
Chat, embeddings and desktop transcription retry connection, timeout, HTTP and response parsing failures; coroutine cancellation propagates.

Streaming retries rebuild the request and parser. Internal, non-serialized streamReset clears failed choices, tool state, held text and usage. Revision-scoped retractions remove only text published by the failed call, preserving earlier calls and live streaming.
Intermediate errors do not reach the UI. Exhaustion returns the final error through the existing response/exception contract.

sharedLogic/src/test/kotlin/ru/souz/llms: Seven passing test methods exercise chat/embeddings/stream failures: connection, timeout, HTTP 400/401/429/500/503, malformed responses and in-band API errors. Two failures followed by success produce exactly three identical request bodies.

A held partial stream renders before completion. Disconnect, EOF, malformed data and in-band errors retract it before restarting. Failed text is absent from history and the recovered tool executes exactly once.
Exhaustion reports only the third error; successful requests, disabled retry wiring and other providers keep one attempt. Cancellation starts no further attempts, including during backoff.
Transcription retries identical WAV/multipart data and preserves the last failure after three attempts.
regression_evidence.agent/src/test/kotlin/ru/souz/agent/node: Sixteen passing cases include reset of published or pending text, discarded tool choices/usage, retention of earlier successful calls and runtime-event retractions.
regression_evidence.sharedUI/src/jvmTest/kotlin/ru/souz/ui/m: Fourteen passing cases include in-place retraction, code-block speech queue recovery, same provisional message ID, and ignoring stale retractions after continuation.
